content.title: Instagram Down—New Outage Leaves Users Unable To Post Or DM
content.text: It’s not just you. Social media site Instagram is down globally, with people unable to post or reply to DMs on the platform.Getty ImagesIt’s not just you. Social media site Instagram is down globally, with people unable to post or reply to DMs on the platform.Issues began early this morning, with a whopping 13,000 reports of problems with Instagram at 04:01 a.m., according to DownDetector. Problems with Instagram include the app, website, login, feed and timeline, posting and server connection, according to the site.Users also took to X, formerly Twitter to complain about the outage. “Is Instagram down rn??? DMs aren’t working for me, is it just me?” one user wrote. “Coming to X to confirm it’s not just me,” wrote another user, Melvin on X. “Instagram DMs are definitely down. ‘Failed to load messages’ is all I’m getting.”PROMOTEDInstagram users also reported issues via Reddit, with one posting: “Instagram failing to load earlier messages. Am I the only one?”It is not known what’s causing the Instagram issues, but it seems to be something technical, rather than a cyberattack. Replies indicated that the Instagram problems relate to a server error, but this is not yet confirmed by the social media app. MORE FOR YOUThere are no reports of outages at Meta other apps, Facebook and WhatsApp, indicating the issue is confined to Instagram itself.It’s not the first time Instagram has had an outage. Almost two years ago to the day I reported Instagram was down alongside its sister site Facebook. The outage even led Elon Musk to post on X boasting that his own site was still up and running. Email Address To be fair, this issue seems to be less widespread than the outage two years ago, but it is still frustrating for those unable to send messages or post on the platform. I have asked Instagram parent Meta for a comment and will update this article if the firm responds. Instagram Down: What To DoInstagram being down is certainly annoying, but there’s not much you can do at the moment other than wait and see. My Instagram account appears to be working fine as of 05:20 a.m. EST, so perhaps the issues are already being resolved. Instagram owner Meta usually responds to any problems quickly, so keep checking back to my story, which I’ll be updating as news comes in.ForbesNew ‘Powerful’ iOS Attack Warning Issued To Millions Of iPhone UsersBy Kate O'Flaherty
